data.gender_notes: Roselle is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rosalon', meaning 'little rose'. In Greek mythology, roses were associated with love, war, and the goddess Aphrodite. The name Roselle carries the meaning “Rose, little rose” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Roselle usually hope their child will grow to embody rose, little rose and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roselle total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The Christian name "Roselle" continues the ancient association of roses with love, beauty, and grace. In literature and art, Roselle is a symbol of the virtues embodied by Jesus, particularly love, purity, and grace.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name "Roselle" carries deeper meaning beyondits beautiful association with roses. It represents the spiritual qualities of Love, Purity, and Grace that followers of Christ are called to embody in their lives. Furthermore, the connection with the Greek goddess Aphrodite highlights the Christian belief that God is the ultimate source of love and beauty in the world. Embracing the name "Roselle" is a constant reminder for the bearer to strive towards these virtues in their daily lives and to glorify God in all they do.
